name: u.u

scripts.build:css: node scripts/build-css.mjs && npm run gen:registry && npm run gen:components
scripts.prepare: svelte-kit sync && npm run gen:registry || echo ''
scripts.check: npm run build:css && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json

description: A pure-CSS component kit in seven families, plus the SvelteKit app that previews it and hands it over as a downloadable bundle. Not an npm package (ADR 0001): the app ships a zip.
